description: A generated recipe. Quantities are approximate by contract — the PRD requires AI quantities be labelled as estimates, and AI cook times are padded 30% at display time.

steps.heading: Blend the base
steps.description: Blend the tomatoes, one onion and the scotch bonnet until smooth. Do not add water — the tomatoes carry enough.

steps.heading: Fry the base
steps.description: Heat the oil, slice in the second onion and fry until it turns translucent. Pour in the blend and fry it down until the oil floats to the top and the raw smell is gone. This is the step people rush; do not rush it.

steps.heading: Cook the rice
steps.description: Stir in the stock cubes, add the washed rice and just enough water to sit level with the rice. Cover tightly and leave it on a low heat.

steps.heading: Fry the plantain
steps.description: While the rice steams, slice the plantain on the diagonal and fry until each side is deep gold. Drain on paper.

steps.heading: Rest and serve
steps.description: Take the rice off the heat and leave it covered for five minutes before stirring. Serve with the plantain on the side.

steps.heading: Boil the beans
steps.description: Rinse the beans and boil in plenty of water until the skins begin to split and a bean crushes easily between two fingers.

steps.heading: Season
steps.description: Drain most of the water, stir in the palm oil, sliced onion and salt, and let it thicken.

steps.heading: Fry the plantain
steps.description: Fry the sliced plantain until deep gold and serve alongside.
